definitions.explanation: a person who easily becomes embarrassed or self-conscious, especially in social situations

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}だ。
{恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm shy, so I'm not good at speaking in front of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: I was shy as a child, but I'm different now.
